text: さかみちでの　ハンドル　さばき　むずかしい　だろ！

structure.jp: さかみちでの　ハンドル　さばき
structure.en: handling the handlebars on a slope

patterns.name: 〜だろう
patterns.explanation: だろう at the end asks the listener to agree, like 'right?'; だろ is the short, rough form. むずかしい　だろ = 'it's hard, isn't it'.

patterns.name: 〜での
patterns.explanation: で says where something is done, and の ties that place to the thing named next. さかみちでの　ハンドル　さばき = 'handlebar handling on a slope'.
